title: 第19章 清明上河园
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“哇塞！好...奇特的店铺。”

    看见全貌的一瞬间，花期的心情如同从高峰坠落的过山车一样刺激。

    谁能来告诉她，是她没睡醒还是在做梦？

    不然为什么会看到一间全是粉红色的店铺。

    屋顶是粉色，装饰是粉色，柜台和桌子都是粉色。

    知道的这是古城，不知道的还以为这是芭比娃娃的城堡。

    花期抬手合上下巴，木着脸点开了系统面板，花了五个声望值重新装修店铺。

    果然，免费准没好事，粉红色的店铺，和古城没有半杆子联系。

    花期在要求里输入了一大堆装修理由。

    要完全参考《清明上河图》的装修风格，将店铺的牌匾、桌椅、收银台及后厨都按宋朝规格打造，把雅致与惬意融入古城。

    她既要长安的雍容，也要汴京的繁华，更要京师的威仪。

    洋洋洒洒写了几百字，检查没有什么问题便提交。

    声望值立刻被扣掉五点，以花期为中心的区域，地板突然升起十道光柱。

    光柱笼罩了店铺及外面街道在内的所有地方。

    花期站在中心，望着光柱内头顶飞舞的画卷。

    牵着孩子逛集市的老翁，挑着货物的小贩沿街叫卖，拱形桥下，船员们正在压桅杆，桥上钻出了一群人对着河道指指点点....

    一幅幅美好的画面从画卷内跳出，像是活生生的古代集市在眼前展现。

    花期在书上看到过清明上河图的美好，这还是人生第一次，通过系统，正儿八经地感受画中世界。

    也不知道这座古城的来源是什么。

    如果是在几千年前的时空，是不是也有古人和她一样，风尘仆仆来到汴京，成为画卷中的一员？

    花期将飘远的心神回笼，光柱不知何时已消失。

    她按了下酥麻的心脏，抬眸望向店铺。

    原木色打底，青石台阶铺就，门户大开，桌椅尽收眼底。

    五颜六色的彩带裹着木质杆子，飘在空中，宛如宝塔一样倒扣在房顶上。

    门楣挂着两个蝴蝶纸灯笼，牌匾黑底金字，写着‘甜品店’三个大字。

    【城主，满分，我给满分，您太会装修了，我感觉都看到了真正的宋朝】

    “这算什么，以后你会看到更多。”

    花期不喜欢“甜品店”这个名字，或者说装修后的铺子已经和这个现代化的名字不适配。

    她在名称这一栏想了想，最终把名字改成——“酥山小筑”。

    酥山，唐朝的甜品，小筑，隐藏在市井中的雅居。

    文字扭曲，四个楷书的‘酥山小筑’浮现在牌匾上。

    花期抬起双手，将左右两边的拇指和食指捏在一起，随后往两边一拉。

    咔嚓，照片上传到终端。

    她编辑好文案，发送到星网账号。
content_en:
"Wow! What a... peculiar shop."

    The moment I saw the whole scene, my mood during flowering was as exciting as a roller coaster falling from the peak.

    Who can tell her if she is awake or is she dreaming?

    Otherwise, why would you see a store full of pink?

    The roof is pink, the decor is pink, the counters and tables are all pink.

    Those who knew it was an ancient city, but those who didn’t knew it thought it was Barbie’s castle.

    Hua Qi raised her hand and closed her chin, opened the system panel with a dull face, and spent five reputation points to renovate the store.

    Sure enough, free is never a good thing, and pink shops have no connection with the ancient city.

    Huaqi entered a lot of reasons for decoration in the request.

    It is necessary to fully refer to the decoration style of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival". The store's plaques, tables and chairs, cashier counters and kitchens are all built according to Song Dynasty specifications, integrating elegance and comfort into the ancient city.

    She wanted the grace of Chang'an, the prosperity of Bianjing, and even more the majesty of the capital.

    I wrote a few hundred words eloquently and submitted it after checking that there were no problems.

    Five points of reputation were immediately deducted, and ten beams of light suddenly rose from the floor in the area centered on the flower period.

    The beam of light enveloped everything including the shop and the street outside.

    Hua Qi stood in the center, looking at the picture scroll flying above her head in the light column.

    Old men were walking around the market with their children, and vendors were selling goods along the street. Under the arched bridge, the crew was pressing the mast, and a group of people emerged from the bridge and pointed at the river...

    Beautiful pictures jumped out of the scroll, like a living ancient market unfolding before your eyes.

    In the flower period, I have seen the beauty of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" in a book. This is the first time in my life that I can experience the world in the painting seriously through the system.

    I don’t know the origin of this ancient city.

    If it were thousands of years ago, would there be ancient people like her who came to Bianjing and became a member of the painting?

    The flowering period brings back the wandering mind, and the beam of light disappears without knowing when.

    She pressed Su Ma's heart and raised her eyes to look at the store.

    The base is in log color, the steps are paved with bluestone, the door is wide open, and tables and chairs are all in sight.

    Colorful ribbons wrapped around wooden poles float in the air and hang upside down on the roof like a pagoda.

    Two butterfly paper lanterns hang on the lintel, and the plaque reads "Dessert Shop" in gold letters on a black background.

    [City Lord, full marks, I give full marks, you are so good at decorating, I feel like I have seen the real Song Dynasty]

    "This is nothing, you will see more in the future."

    Hua Qi doesn't like the name "dessert shop", or the renovated shop no longer suits this modern name.

    She thought about the name column and finally changed the name to "Sushan Xiaozhu".

    Sushan, the dessert of the Tang Dynasty, Xiaozhu, an elegant residence hidden in the market.

    The text is distorted, and the four words "Sushan Xiaozhu" in regular script appear on the plaque.

    Hua Qi raised his hands, pinched the left and right thumbs and index fingers together, and then pulled them to both sides.

    Click, the photo is uploaded to the terminal.

    She edited the copy and sent it to the Xingwang account.
